body:
## What it does

Its one job is credit-card and airline points, so you never spend longer than a moment deciding how to book. Redemptions and miles get worked out for you rather than by you. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @poteto shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
